value.summary: The change replaces the `next_state` field on `HiveTurn` with `watermark` and `round_start`, adding a `round_start` value of `u64::MAX` to the test fixture `turn()`.  The semantics documented in the comment (a round of one, withholding nothing) match the value `u64::MAX` because the project‑for logic withholds rows strictly above `round_start`, so no row will ever have a sequence above `MAX`.  The change is safe to merge.
